reason: A close international-earthquake precedent has Russian rescuers working with Chinese counterparts to extract a trapped survivor, supporting the existing leading pair. China has the strongest recent record of large overseas urban-search deployments and Russia fields comparable emergency teams; Cuba and neighboring Colombia remain meaningful Venezuela-specific alternatives.

June 23 reporting confirms a June 29 government-corporate regional investment briefing and says non-capital semiconductor investment is expected to focus on advanced packaging. That corroborates the previously reported Gwangju packaging proposal and further weakens capital-region Yongin, although officials still have not formally named the site.
